sections.description:
South Africa’s go-to payment gateway for safe, convenient card and EFT payments.

Plugin Overview

The MustangPay payment plugin is specifically designed for the South African market, supporting four localized payment methods: Card Payments, EFT, 1Voucher, and Payshap. Its goal is to enhance the checkout experience, reduce cart abandonment rates, and increase conversion rates. The plugin is easy to install and integrate, compatible with major e-commerce platforms, and helps merchants streamline the payment process while meeting the payment needs of South African consumers.

  • Supported Payment Methods: Card Payments, EFT, 1Voucher, Payshap
  • Goal: Improve the checkout experience, reduce abandonment, and increase conversion rates
  • Easy Installation: Quick integration, reducing the technical burden on merchants, compatible with leading e-commerce platforms

Detailed Payment Methods

Card Payments

  • Features: Supports major global credit and debit card payments.
  • How it Helps Merchants: Increases conversion rates, simplifies payment process, complies with PCI requirements, ensures secure transactions.
  • Customer Experience: Secure and convenient, autofill feature enhances payment efficiency.

EFT

  • Features: Provides a convenient bank card payment method, especially suitable for South African consumers.
  • How it Helps Merchants: Simplifies the payment process, increases conversion rates, reduces payment costs, complies with PCI requirements, ensures transaction security.
  • Customer Experience: Quick, seamless payment process, automatic card information filling enhances efficiency and reduces steps.

1Voucher

  • Features: Uses cash vouchers for online payments, suitable for consumers without bank accounts or credit cards.
  • How it Helps Merchants: Expands the customer base by reaching local consumers who cannot use traditional payment methods, grows market reach.
  • Customer Experience: Convenient, no bank card needed, ideal for consumers without credit cards.

Payshap

  • Features: Mobile-based, fast payment method, designed for local customers.
  • How it Helps Merchants: Offers a low-cost local payment option, expands customer reach.
  • Customer Experience: Easy payment process, fits well with South African consumers’ payment habits.

Increase Conversions and Merchant Revenue

  • Reduce Cart Abandonment: Offering multiple payment options helps reduce cart abandonment caused by payment method mismatches.
  • Increase Checkout Conversion: Simplify the payment process, reduce friction during payment steps, and improve payment success rates.
  • Support Local Payment Options: By integrating EFT, 1Voucher, and Payshap, merchants can reach more local consumers and boost order volumes.

Next Steps

  • Contact Business Email: To start using our plugin, feel free to reach out to our business team at [business@mustangpay.com].
  • Integration Documentation: Please refer to our integration guide for detailed installation and configuration instructions to easily get started with the plugin.

Why Choose MustangPay

  • Fraud Detection: Advanced risk control system that monitors transactions in real-time to protect merchants from fraud risks.
  • Plugin Updates: Regularly introducing new features to stay at the forefront of payment technology.
  • Compatibility Updates: Ongoing updates to ensure compatibility with e-commerce platforms.
  • Technical Support: •24/7 technical support to ensure smooth merchant operations.
  • South African Compliance: Fully compliant with South African payment regulations (e.g., PCI DSS) and supports 3D Secure authentication to ensure transaction security.

Legal Disclaimers

The MustangPay payment plugin fully complies with GDPR regulations, ensuring the privacy and security of user data. We employ advanced data encryption and processing technologies to protect both merchant and consumer sensitive information. All payment transactions are processed in an environment that meets international security standards, allowing merchants to confidently use our payment platform for global transactions.

This plugin API addresses

  • https://openapi.mustangpay.co.za: The address is the official production environment access request address of MustangPay

External services

This plugin connects to MustangPay’s payment gateway API to process payments.

  • Service provider: Mustangpay (https://www.mustangpay.co.za)
  • Data transmitted: Order details (amount, currency, order ID), customer IP address
  • When data is sent: During payment processing and order status checks
  • Terms of service: https://www.mustangpay.co.za/user-terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy policy: https://www.mustangpay.co.za/privacy-policy

Remove plugin

  1. Deactivate plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  2. Delete plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.installation:
Requirements

To install and configure WooCommerce PayPal Payments, you will need:

  • WordPress Version 6.3 or newer (installed)
  • WooCommerce Version 6.9 or newer (installed and activated)
  • PHP Version 7.4 or newer
  • PayPal business or personal account

Installation instructions

  1. Log in to WordPress admin.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for the WooCommerce MustangPay Payments plugin.
  4. Click on Install Now and wait until the plugin is installed successfully.
  5. You can activate the plugin immediately by clicking on Activate now on the success page. If you want to activate it later, you can do so via Plugins > Installed Plugins.

Setup and Configuration

Follow the steps below to connect the plugin to your MustangPay account:

  1. After you have activated the WooCommerce MustangPay Payments plugin, go to WooCommerce > Settings.
  2. Click the Payments tab.
  3. Click on the Activate MustangPay button.
  4. setting Merchant ID，mustangPayPublicKey，rsaPrivateKey，rsaPublicKey
  5. Click Save changes.

Updating

Automatic updates should work generally smoothly, but we still recommend you back up your site.

If you encounter issues with the Mustang Pay buttons not appearing after an update, purge your website cache. CachingorJavaScript minification
sections.faq:
What is MustangPay?

MustangPay is a payment platform created by a team of technical experts, designed to provide customized payment solutions for both business clients (B2B) and consumers (B2C). For merchants, our services help them manage payment processes, enhance transaction security, and optimize business decisions through data analysis. For consumers, we ensure that the payment process is not only fast but also secure, enhancing the overall shopping experience.

Why does MustangPay appear on my billing statement when I don’t recall any related transactions？

MustangPay serves as a payment service provider for a variety of businesses, handling transactions securely on their behalf. When you make a purchase through a merchant that uses our platform, the transaction is processed by MustangPay, which is why our name appears on your billing statement instead of the merchant’s. If you see MustangPay on your statement and want to confirm the details of the transaction, please refer to the SMS or email notifications sent by the merchant that you received at the time of purchase. These communications provide further details to help you recall the specific transaction facilitated through our service.

Is it safe to make payments using MustangPay?

At MustangPay, the security of your transactions is our top priority. We utilize 3D Secure (3DS) verification technology and strictly adhere to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI DSS) to protect every transaction, ensuring your payment information is completely secure.

How do I report a problem with my transaction?

If you have any questions or concerns about a particular transaction, please provide the specific order number, date, and amount, and contact us as soon as possible through our customer service channels. Our team will respond promptly to your inquiry and provide the necessary assistance to resolve your concerns.

What should I do if I encounter a problem during a transaction?

If you experience any issues while using MustangPay, you can seek assistance from our customer support team at any time. We offer multiple contact methods, including email and online chat services, to ensure your payment experience is smooth and worry-free.

What are your fees and transaction charges?

Our fees vary depending on the type of transaction and the services used. For detailed information on our pricing structure, please visit our Pricing page or contact our sales team at support@mustangpay.co.za.

Why is my payment not going through?

Payment fluctuations can occasionally occur due to temporary issues in the payment processing system. If you encounter difficulty, we recommend trying the transaction again after some time or using an alternative payment method. Should the problem persist, please contact our support team for further assistance.

Contact Us?

Please contact support@mustangpay.co.za if you have any problems.
We value queries from every customers!
